# Gliglish

> > Gliglish is an AI-powered language learning platform that enables users to practice speaking and pronunciation in multiple languages through conversational AI interactions.

Founded by Fabien Snauwaert, Gliglish offers an innovative approach to language acquisition by providing real-time speaking practice with an AI teacher. The platform supports numerous languages including Filipino (Tagalog), Modern Standard Arabic, Serbian, Norwegian bokmål, and many others, with both free and premium options available.

## Key Topics

- AI language teacher
- Speaking practice
- Pronunciation training
- Conversational AI
- Speech recognition
- Multiple languages (Filipino, Tagalog, Modern Standard Arabic, Serbian, Norwegian bokmål)
- Conversation practice
- AI tutor
- Scenario-based learning
- Multilingual speech recognition
- Free language learning
- ChatGPT-powered interactions
- Real-time feedback
- Language app

## Core Platform

- [Gliglish · Learn languages by speaking with AI](https://gliglish.com): Main homepage showcasing Gliglish's AI-powered language learning platform with interactive speaking practice
- [Free AI Language Teacher · Gliglish](https://gliglish.com/free): Free tier access to Gliglish AI teacher supporting multiple languages including English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and more

## Localized Versions

- [Gliglish · Aprenda idiomas conversando com IA](https://gliglish.com/intl/pt): Portuguese-language version of the Gliglish platform homepage
